from glom.core import glom

target = {
    'users': [
        {'name': 'Ada', 'score': 3},
        {'name': 'Bob', 'score': 5},
        {'name': 'Cy', 'score': 8},
    ]
}
names = glom(target, ('users', ['name']))
summary = {name: len(name) + index for index, name in enumerate(names)}
target['summary'] = summary

print(names)
print(summary)
print(target)
